strings.en: I shall show you my power.
Wherever you flee, it is futile.
It has been a while, Roa.
I shall make sure you never fly again.
Regret ever becoming involved with Roa.
Clad in a dragon or not, it is futile.
I shall fight you on your own ground.
An azure dragon is no match for me.
The day has come to cast away your royal name.
Wings or no, you cannot escape me.
You have made a foolish choice.
My duty is not yet done...!
Hm... Am I being pushed back?
Oh... To inflict such wounds on me...!
Roa... I shall not forgive you.
Could Emmy be lending you power...?
That which lies hidden in that body...
That power... must not be underestimated.
So this is the fusion of dragon and tiger...!
To overwhelm even me...!/　I must admit, impressive...!
That will not shatter my body.
Do not think this will win you the fight.
I shall strip that dragon from you...!
You, a Dragon King... I do not accept it.
Do you understand the gap in our power?
Compatible Kaiser... Not what you once were.
That aura... Was it my imagination?
And you call yourself a Dragon King?
No need even to read that.
Not with so incompetent a pilot.
No matter how many times, the result is the same.
There is no escape from this storm.
I shall drag you to hell.
